Maya Lin: Quick question 1 1 — contractor on parental leave crossed the carryover cutoff during LOA, policy says carryover cap applies but this seems unfair. Can we make an exception?
Jordan (People Ops): Which contractor and what dates? We do have LOA carve-outs sometimes but need manager + payroll sign-off.
Maya Lin: cid:4456 - part-time (0.6 FTE), parental leave from 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28, hit year-end carryover cap on 2025-12-31. They were approved for LOA before cutoff.
Ravi (Payroll): Typical rule: carryover allowed only up to cap unless LOA pre-approved before cutoff and HR flagged. Do we have pre-approval note in HRIS?
Maya Lin: HRIS note exists but the system still enforced cap during accrual run. Looks like the LOA flag didn't carry into the accrual batch job.
Jordan (People Ops): Ok send HRIS record export and manager approval. We'll need manager attestation for exception per audit.
Maya Lin: Pasting snippet (sanitized):
```
HRIS.get_record(4456) -> {
  status: "on_leave",
  leave_type: "parental",
  leave_start: "2025-11-01",
  leave_end: "2026-02-28",
  manager_approval: "2025-10-20"
}
```
Ava (People Ops Manager): I confirm I approved LOA on 2025-10-20 and I approve carryover exception to restore capped hours.
Ravi (Payroll): Thanks Ava. I'll run manual accrual adjustment and post journal id. Command: payroll_tools/adjust_accrual --id 4456 --restore_carryover 8h --reason "LOA pre-approved"
HRIS Bot: accrual_adjustment queued id AJ-2026-554
Ravi (Payroll): Adjustment applied, AJ-2026-554. Balances updated, no retro tax impact expected. Added detection HR_LOA_045 to prevent LOA flag loss during accrual syncs.
Jordan (People Ops): Great. I'll add a short internal note: "If LOA approved before cutoff, submit manager attestation + HRIS export to People Ops and Payroll will process manual restore." Will update the policy page.
Maya Lin: Thanks all 1 :heart:
Jordan (People Ops): Closing; filing ticket HR-2026-390 for audit trail. If anyone sees similar for part-time contractors, ping me.
